GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.
   C. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.

2. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   C. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Fishing as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

5. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   B. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   D. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   C. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   B. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.
   C. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.
   B. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Trade as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

13. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   C. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Lakes as rumours only.

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

15. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   D. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.

16. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Glaciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Settlement and urbanisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Lakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
